enas.boundary: ME/HE/UE are manual one-row error annotations. Five logged state changes of persistence are an explicit transfer adapter, not a source label duration. The source supplies error categories but no exact tag-level cause set.

piade.boundary: PIADE exposes time-varying process inputs/outputs and speed but no feature-level causal truth. Contribution activation and stability are reportable; root Top-k/MRR and superiority are prohibited.

imaks.boundary: Synthetic but physically plausible dataset with an explicit ST02 current to ST04 speed correlated edge. It can validate plumbing and falsify detection, not grant real-industrial or cited-paper score credit.

controlled_chain.boundary: Generated causal chain used only to exercise distinct-lag IGDTE indirect-edge pruning.

evidence_policy.book_4_2_igdte: E1 if the controlled pruning beacon passes; retain the existing 21-unit real-data no-pruning result and deny E2 until a real causal triangle activates.
evidence_policy.book_4_3_recursive_bn: E2 if EnAS real-data posterior movement and nonempty persistent-event decisions pass; semantic alignment remains descriptive because exact cause tags are absent.
evidence_policy.book_4_4_plr_rca: E2 if grouped PIADE windows produce finite nonnegative contributions above the frozen activation rate; causal accuracy remains unavailable.
